offering_description.value: Provides management services to publicly traded REITs and other real estate owners, including property management, construction oversight, asset management and advisory across office, healthcare, senior living, hotel and industrial properties. It earns fees for managing these companies and their properties, and is paid by the companies it manages.

primary_services.value: property management; construction management; asset management; business management; advisory services

customer_segment.value: B2B: publicly traded REITs and real estate companies that it manages

end_markets.value: office real estate; healthcare and senior living real estate; hotels; industrial and logistics real estate; commercial mortgage lending

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: base and incentive management fees paid by managed REITs; service fees: property management and construction management fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs properties and operations for REITs, paid by them, serving publicly traded REIT owners

geography_served.value: US national: properties and managed companies across most US states

specialization.value: related lines: property management, construction management, asset management and advisory for managed REITs

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: management agreements negotiated directly with REITs and real estate owners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: registered investment adviser rules under SEC oversight, plus REIT, securities and real estate rules

notes: Company size and exact service mix are best estimates from general knowledge.
